status: Original adaptable design recommendations informed by regionally inspected papers. These are not a corporate house style or measurements unless stated by a source atlas entry.

type.math: Use a compatible math family; never infer type from page body when figure is raster or outlined.

export_font_strategy.status: Production recommendation; source family and chosen production family are recorded separately.
export_font_strategy.matplotlib_pdf_fonttype_42: Select actual TrueType regular and bold font programs. Confirm the program signature, not only filename extension; CFF OpenType programs can cause a format mismatch in this path.
export_font_strategy.other_backends: Use a format supported by the export backend and verify the rendered PDF. CFF is not universally unsupported.

type.default_family: Match the manuscript body; LaTeX/Times papers -> serif with mathtext.fontset='stix'. Implemented by scripts/paperkit.py use_fonts().

structured_system.note: Use only roles present in the actual system; the update amber pair is an adapted recommendation, not an extracted Harness color.

token_architecture.note: Select a subset according to scientific roles; do not combine all categories gratuitously. Dark inks are adaptation choices unless separately measured in atlas.

analytical_comparison.note: Series colors are extracted; widths, marker sizes, and alpha are original recommendations. Preserve all relevant conditions at readable contrast.

sources: Automated Researchers Can Reliably Mitigate Alignment Failures, official2026-08-28 Fig.1
warm_editorial.note: The peach is a mark/fill color; use dark labels instead of peach small text. Combine with shape/line encoding.

algorithm_correspondence.status: Original opaque production recommendations; source structural correspondence is observed.
algorithm_correspondence.note: Use a role only if present. Repeat its exact ink in matching code identifiers; ordinary syntax remains neutral. Colors do not establish corporate branding.

provenance_expansion.status: Original opaque production recommendations; source provenance grouping and typed objects are observed.
provenance_expansion.note: Provide a provenance key. State is an optional separate role; do not combine provenance and modality into one ambiguous hue mapping.

stage_storyboard.status: Pale fills are observed vector values; dark text inks, footer, dimensions and font sizes are authoring recommendations.
stage_storyboard.note: The third ink is darkened from observed #E97132. Use four stages only if the method has four stages. Interiors must contain meaningful operations and outputs, not decorative icons.

evidence_rules: Separate source values from adaptation choices.
Inspect selected palette and all text at final printed size.
Ratios are starting templates, not inferred universal optima.
No theme alone certifies color accessibility.
Retain raw color, alpha and background separately; an opaque rendered sample is a different evidence type.
Do not use hidden text or local font fallback as evidence of the source visible font.
Reject physically implausible raw stroke widths before using them as final-size design values.
Dashed-line meanings are defined per figure; training-only, optionality, copying and expansion are distinct roles.

role_families_2026_10.status: Recommended paperkit palette (references/visual-craft.md §3). fill L*95-97, soft L*88-90, stroke L*55-65, ink L*25-35, mark saturated.
